label: default scope
type: the `_default` scope automatically created in every new bucket. Cannot be dropped.
evidence: Every created bucket is automatically given a _default scope_, and within it, a _default collection_.
The default scope cannot be dropped.
note: Promoted with server:default-collection and server:system-scope as the three automatically-created members of a bucket's namespace, all three carrying deletion constraints that differ in a way no single page contrasts: the default scope cannot be dropped at all, the default collection CAN be dropped but cannot then be recreated, and the _system scope and its collections cannot be dropped.
